en: Color postcard showing a crowded Black Sea resort scene: a hexagonal swimming pool and sunbathing terrace in the foreground, with many parasols; behind it a wide sandy beach with colorful umbrellas and several pink geodesic dome cabanas; breakwaters and small islets in the calm sea. The back is printed with Romanian publisher details and a caption identifying the place as Olimp.
